title: A new airtight sampling method for sulfur hexafluoride (SF6) in groundwater
author: Sunderland, Larsen, et al.

steps.title: Traditional non‑airtight sampling
steps.instruction: Collect 1 L of groundwater directly from the well after 3–5 bottle‑volumes have overflowed from a Boston round bottle; insert a sampling tube into the bottom of the bottle, add water to the conical seal‑screw cap to displace air, cap the bottle, inspect for air bubbles, store at ~4 °C, bind the cap with electrical tape and ship for GC‑ECD analysis.

steps.title: Traditional air‑sensitive sampling
steps.instruction: Using a Boston round 1 L bottle, immerse the bottle in a bucket overflowing with groundwater, cap the bottle underwater, then handle as in the non‑airtight method (bubble check, refrigeration, tape, shipment).

steps.title: Prepare 2021 airtight bottles (pre‑field nitrogen purge)
steps.instruction: About one hour before field work, purge each 1 L bottle with low‑pressure nitrogen for ~5 min, seal the modified lid (silicone grommet with inflow and outflow tubes sealed by silicone gel), and wrap the lid and bottle tightly with parafilm.

steps.title: 2021 airtight prototype field sampling
steps.instruction: Connect the inflow tube to the well, open the inlet valve and allow 3–5 bottle‑volumes of water to exit via the outflow tube, then cap both tubes; remove the modified lid, fill the bottle with sampling water, seal with the conical screw cap, examine for bubbles, refrigerate (~4 °C), tape the cap and ship for GC‑ECD analysis.

steps.title: Construct and evacuate 2022 airtight bottle
steps.instruction: Assemble a Boston round bottle without silicone components; evacuate by opening the inlet valve (outlet closed) and applying a standard vacuum pump for 5 min to near 0 mmHg, verify pressure of 2–15 mmHg with a manometer, and maintain this pressure for 24 h; perform all evacuation in a hood with a shatter shield.

steps.title: Nitrogen purge for 2022 bottle
steps.instruction: Connect nitrogen (99.99 % SF6‑free, low pressure) to the inlet, open the outlet valve for 5 min while keeping the inlet closed, then close the outlet first, close the inlet, and shut off the nitrogen source to leave a nitrogen‑filled, air‑free bottle.

steps.title: 2022 airtight field sampling procedure
steps.instruction: Install ¼‑inch polyethylene tubing from the well spigot to the inlet valve before opening the well; purge the well until geochemical data are stable; turn the evacuated bottle upside‑down, keep water pressure low, open the inlet valve while keeping the outlet closed until the bottle is at least half full, then open the outlet valve to allow air to collect at the bottom where a copper wire removes bubbles; fill to full, rotate the bottle upside‑down to move any remaining bubbles to the copper wire and out through the outlet, close outlet then inlet, remove tubing, and place the sample on ice (~4 °C) or at room temperature according to laboratory guidance (USGS: room temp; University of Utah: ice/refrigerator). Ship for GC‑ECD analysis.
